narratives.author: claude
narratives.headline: Five-game Tuesday, four rebound props and one assist prop, all priced before the injury reports settle
narratives.briefing: It is a five-game night with every game still to tip, and the report starts the day at 0-0-0 with no closing-line history yet. The edge the model sees is concentrated in props: four Unders and a Towns Over, led by Sandro Mamukelashvili Under 7.5 rebounds at conviction 56, while Towns at conviction 42 grades as a Pass. Every prop is Holding at its published price, and nothing has crossed a kill line this morning. The game-line leans are mostly Unders, but game lines are 10-19 (-10.13u) since 2026-11-11, so treat them as leans only. Before tip we are waiting on official reports, in particular Jonathan Kuminga (Day-To-Day) for MIN, and on how the Lakers fill the minutes left by Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler, and how Detroit's frontcourt absences shape the rebounding in San Antonio.

cards.p|4278580|reb|Under: The sim has him under 7.5 in 79% of games with an average of 5.8, he stayed under in 8 of his last 10, and CHA games offer -10% rebounds vs the league. The risk is minutes: he is projected for 29.4 with Reaves and Kessler out, and his overs came when he played long, so a bigger starting role at center is what would make this wrong.
cards.p|5104157|reb|Under: The model projects 9.2 against a 12.5 line, the sim goes under in 69% of games, and he stayed under 12.5 in all of his last 5. What argues against it is his history vs DET (16.5 rebounds per game in 2 games) and DET giving power forwards +6% rebounds; with Detroit thin up front tonight, more boards may be available than the model assumes.
cards.p|4433249|reb|Under: The sim goes under 9.5 in 72% of games with an average of 8.1, LAL is the #3 toughest matchup for power-forward rebounds, and he averaged 4.5 rebounds per game in 2 games vs LAL. The line already moved against it from 8.5 to 9.5, and a usage bump of +16% without Knueppel is the main way this misses.
cards.p|5037871|ast|Under: DET is the #2 toughest defense on shooting-guard assists (-12%), the sim goes under 4.5 in 69% of games, and he stayed under in 4 of the last 5. A long night above his 28.7-minute projection is the risk, since his overs came at 33.5 minutes.
cards.p|3136195|reb|Over: He is averaging 14.5 rebounds over his last 10 against a 12.5 line and the sim clears it in 69% of games, but conviction is only 42 and the report grades it a Pass. Blowout risk is real, with 36% of sims ending 15+ points apart, and the play-to price at −103 leaves almost no room.

narratives.leans_note: The leans are four Unders and DET +9.5, with POR @ MIN already past its play-to, and given the 10-19 game-line record none of them is a best bet.
